entries.title: Pixi world map canvas + anchors layer
Quest POI sigilli on the continent map
World event card + goblin invasion sticker/marker
entries.notes: The goblin event card+sticker were already visible at S1 on the audited build (invasion in progress in the save). S15 drives the canonical trigger.

entries.title: Fullscreen event shroud veil over the map
entries.notes: aria-hidden fullscreen layer, always mounted; the meaningful state is "covered" during an event theatre (dims/grades the map).

entries.title: Current-objective cartouche (top-left)
entries.notes: Renders null on /game today: the page mounts the slot but never passes an objective. Assertion expects absence; document a shot only if an objective feed lands.

entries.title: Village view (stage, plaque, legend, registry chip)
Building pins on the village stage
entries.notes: 11 pins witnessed (lumbermill, quarry, farm, warehouse, inn, smithy, market, infirmary, palisade, watchtower, barracks). Level shown as roman numeral or "+".

entries.title: Worker slot overlay on village buildings
Roster stage panel (V2 materic roster)
entries.notes: Stage-managed panel (left wing). Also force-opens beside the expedition planner as the party picker. Shortcut r.

entries.title: Event ledger panel (hanging tab)
entries.notes: Stage-managed panel (right wing). Shortcut e; also listed in the Panels menu.

entries.title: Director panel (staging actions)
entries.notes: Dev/trailer instrument — enabled on /game via gameFrameConfig debug.directorPanel=true. Shortcut d; also in Panels menu.

entries.title: Tuning panel (live config sliders)
entries.notes: Dev instrument. Shortcut t; also in Panels menu.

entries.title: Hero sheet panel (resident detail)
entries.notes: Opens on hover INTENT over a roster rail card (clicks cancel intent; the p shortcut needs a mounted rail). Selector is the element id, not a testid.

entries.title: Expedition planner floating panel
entries.notes: FloatingPanel chrome (minimize/close). Includes party slot rack, exposure cells, loadout/bag, forecast column.

entries.title: Quest run window (theatre, beats, choices, belt, log, amanuense, epilogue)
entries.notes: BLOCKER witnessed 2026-10-24: expedition demoLaunch throws "Cannot access X before initialization" (TDZ circular import) and the ErrorBoundary catches it — on the frozen preview AND the dev server. Quest-run states unreachable this session; selectors taken from source.

entries.title: Quest stage cluster: run window + skill-check column/wings
entries.notes: Mounts the astrolabe V6.2 kit (DestinyAstrolabeV62Standalone) + verdict card; overlay variant when the window is minimised. Same TDZ blocker as quest-run-window.

entries.title: Quest reward popup / settlement report
entries.notes: Same TDZ blocker as quest-run-window.

entries.title: On-map expedition route with progress glint
entries.notes: Drawn on the map while a run travels; may sit behind the run window when open. Same TDZ blocker.

entries.title: Post-check outcome toast
entries.notes: Transient toast after a resolved check (QuestOutcomeToastHost). Same TDZ blocker.

entries.title: Title screen (continue/new/load/settings)
entries.notes: Shown only via ?title=1, Tauri launch, or the post-quit session flag — a plain /game visit goes straight into the game. Driver navigates with ?title=1.

entries.title: Boot veil / loading screen
entries.notes: Transient: phases manifest→assets→ready; gone by the time the map is interactable. Capture races the boot.

entries.title: Settings dialog (language, interface size, reduced motion)
entries.notes: Same dialog mounts from the title screen (S14 path needs ?title=1 on plain browser) and from the in-game HUD menu → Settings.

entries.title: Load game dialog
entries.notes: Also opens from the title screen Load button.

entries.title: Memorial panel (fallen residents)
entries.notes: In-game HUD menu → Memorial.

entries.title: Settlement-lost takeover overlay
entries.notes: No canonical in-game trigger yet (day-30 loss path out of scope); staged via Director action settlementLost.

entries.title: Hero level-up ceremony layer
entries.notes: Staged via Director action levelup (opens roster if needed).

entries.title: Legacy reliquary panel (equipment slots)
entries.notes: Only reachable via Director action legacy (PLAN-067 T-C4 staging).

entries.title: Map region name plate on hover
entries.notes: Pointer-events:none plate over a painted map region; mounts on regionHover. Selector distinguishes it from the radix HUD tooltip.

entries.title: HUD control tooltip plate (radix)
entries.notes: Shared hover tooltip for HUD chrome (nav items, corner controls, plaques). Mounts in a portal after 350 ms.

entries.title: Stage edge strips: collapsed-panel tabs and wing rails
entries.notes: Container is always mounted (fullscreen, aria-hidden when empty). Edge tabs appear only when a stage-managed panel is collapsed; wing rails when a zone is squeezed ≤ wingRailPx. S6 (planner+roster wings) is the most reliable populated regime witnessed.

entries.title: ErrorBoundary fallback (crash screen)
entries.notes: Default assertion expects ABSENCE (a healthy /game shows no error). It was WITNESSED this session covering the whole route after the quest-run TDZ crash.

entries.title: New-game confirm dialog (title screen)
entries.notes: Mounts only when info.hasProgress; a fresh profile skips it (driver returns unreachable honestly). Driver navigates via ?title=1 then clicks the New Game pill.
